The Mug · Kettle · Cup tier is [retired](/internal/docs/agent-insights/mug-kettle-cup-tier-is-retired); **su + GOAL mode drive the app**. This doc is the account of how the autoloop's *duties* were ported onto the goal system — under the plan's governing principle ([owner 2026-08-23], `work-on-everything-goal-2026-08-23#D-001`): *bring the autoloop's features inside the goal system **without changing the goal system's design***. The duty-by-duty replacement table lives in the retirement doc; this page documents the goal-system features that made the port real.

## Standing goals (the substrate)

A **standing goal** is a goal with `goals.standing = true` (migration 913, with a partial index). It is *defined* by not having a checkable outcome:

- **Exempt from checkable-outcome phrasing.** A standing goal is never asked to "propose a stopping condition" — that was a real pre-port defect, where a standing goal was told to invent the checkable outcome it is defined as not having.
- **Kill = tripwires + owner stop, never an outcome check.** The polarity (`STANDING_GOAL_KILL_POLARITY`, in the existing kill-criterion module) is delivered **at the BRIEF, not as a criterion mandate** (`#D-003`) — the brief tells the agent what kind of goal it is driving; the criterion machinery is unchanged.
- **Rolling budget window, not a lifetime ceiling.** `goals.budget_window_sec` (migrations 914 + 918, validated CHECK). `enforceGoalBreaches` judges a standing goal's spend over its declared **trailing window** and names the window in the kill reason; a lifetime `budget_cents` comparison would be a scheduled auto-kill for a goal that accrues forever (normal goals keep the lifetime ceiling).

## Goals ↔ plans parity (Phase 1b)

- **Blocked-by PLANS** (P-019, rulings in `#D-004`): goal `blockedBy` accepts `plan:<harness>/<slug>` refs — shipped = satisfied, superseded = invalidating, worst-verdict fold on ambiguity. Feeds the existing activation gate + became-ready offers.
- **Triggers can start goals** (P-020, `#D-006`/`#D-007`): one goal-activation primitive; the schedule/trigger legs converge on it. A goal's authored schedule is stored **on the routine row itself** — no goals schedule column, no metadata bag (`#D-007`), mirroring how plan schedules materialize a routine.
- **Goal input/output schemas** (P-021): typed inputs collected at start, declared outputs reported at achieve/kill — mirroring plans' `input_schema`/`output_schema`, surfaced through the package format and the start door.

## Durable engine properties (what the watchdogs used to do)

- **Pause parks** (P-002): a paused standing goal starts no new work and its agent parks — consuming `goal-live-holder-guarantee-2026-08-18`'s persisted paused-vs-lost signal.
- **Respawn-on-loss** (P-010, e2e-verified): a started package goal carries holder policy `{ requireLive: true, onLoss: 'respawn' }` — kill its session and it comes back, no human. The goal-holder respawner derives verdicts from real dead-session signals (see `goal-holder-respawn.integration.test.ts`).
- **Loop circuit parity** (P-012, `#D-008`): the steward's `loop:arm` loop IS circuit-covered (failure-streak fire-gate + cost caps); a wedged steward surfaces via escalation + auto-pause + the goal-holder layer — **deliberately never a chronic-sweep claimable bug**.
- **Operator-boot arm** (P-011): on operator start, an active un-paused standing goal with no live holder is respawned — ships **DARK behind explicit owner arming** (owner-authority category). This is the deliberate answer to the retirement doc's open loss #3 (cold-start autonomy): recovery from the su population reaching zero is now an explicit, owner-armed choice rather than a discovery.

## The entry point: goal packages in the Cupboard

`#D-002` ([owner]): the "go" button is a **Cupboard goal PACKAGE, bundled with the release — install ≠ start**. Install lands an INACTIVE stub (no agent, no spend, no-clobber); a deliberate start door (`goals:start` family, P-017) applies the standing defaults (holder respawn policy, drain-fleet auto-mint, rolling budget window), collects the typed inputs, and builds the kickoff brief pointer-to-contract style. Additions ratified in `#D-005`: a package MAY carry a **pure `construct(typedInputs)` → spec** run at START in the code:run sandbox (P-022); goals/plans carry **typed custom properties** (`property_schema` → datatype registry, one `properties` jsonb, provenance-stamped writes emitting orient-visible deltas — P-023) with a declarative **datatype display spec** for the HUD editors (P-024). The bundled **work-on-everything** package ports the mug duties body (triage taxonomy, Blender loop, steer-don't-dispatch, completion mandate — P-007), and its ordered `worklist` property (`list<plan-ref>`) IS the priority the standing agent drives (P-025).

**Status at authoring (2026-08-23):** the Phase 1/1b/3 substrate above is shipped and verified; the Cupboard entry (P-006 and its dependents) is landing — the authoritative check is `cupboard:search kind='goal'`, never this page.

## What was audited, what was ported, what was dropped

The retirement doc's residual-loss caveat is closed by `work-on-everything-goal-2026-08-23#D-009`: five un-audited areas verified **covered by live machinery** (transcript caps → the context-doors/compaction stack; claim-integrity → the claim-integrity-sweep routine + stale-claims machinery; co-location → the `affinity(bee.held_paths,item.paths)` rank function in the live claim-spec resolver; cross-pot sovereignty → the deliberately-ungated cross-hive boundary + the GOAL-mode standing clause; the precomputed-brief delta → `coord:orient`'s one-call fold + the loop wake's server-composed carry), and **one port filed**: WI-41149, a live writer for the `cursed` N-strikes breaker (the only leg with no live analog).
